objective: Build the job-intelligence and application-pack workers: JD analyzer, company/role research brief, CV-tailoring handoff, cover-letter handoff, independent truth/completeness review and deterministic owner submission gate.
prerequisites: Career Ops canonical job record and CV workflow source paths must be identified.
allowed_scope: Define a structured JobBrief schema: source/provenance, requirements, responsibilities, eligibility, useful keywords, risks/unknowns, company facts with citations/provenance where available.
Implement JD analysis without converting preferences into facts or inventing requirements.
Build a company/role research brief interface that can use web/browser tooling when available, and otherwise records research-needed rather than guessing.
Pass only source-supported facts into CV and cover-letter workflows; preserve canonical owner/profile data.
Implement an independent Application Pack Reviewer that checks truthfulness, requirement coverage, consistency, formatting/export readiness and unresolved unknowns.
Implement a Submission Gate that always requires owner approval before any external application action.
Run a representative local fixture/safe-data acceptance from job record -> JobBrief -> CV draft -> cover-letter draft -> reviewer -> owner gate.
stop_conditions: No secrets/private source dumps in GitHub.
notes: Part of the owner-mandated 2026-09-24 morning engineering cutoff. Continue independently around owner-only credential/admin blockers; record those in tasks-or-issues/overnight-owner-actions-2026-09-24.md. Do not duplicate equivalent pending/running work.

result.summary: Built and evidenced the job-intelligence and application-pack workers (roster B13/B14/B17/B18) for task agent-job-intelligence-and-application-pack-2026-09-23. career-ops/job_intelligence.py + job_brief_schema.json produce a structured JobBrief that is extractive only: every requirement/responsibility/eligibility line is a verbatim posting line with its 1-based source_line and section; desirable/preferred lines are recorded as preferences and can never appear as essential requirements; labelled posting terms (Location:/Right to work:) are routed out of the requirements bucket; candidate_claims is always empty and a first-person-claim scanner fails the build if one appears; an eligibility condition is 'satisfied_by_owner_source' only when a canonical owner source states it (cited by file and line) and is otherwise 'unknown' with a blocker risk (the UK fixture is met by the owner's own profile; a UAE work-permit fixture stays unknown). The research brief interface accepts company facts only with source+citation, rejects uncited facts, and with no provider returns research_needed plus the exact requested list; the http provider is disabled (no owner-approved endpoint) and the browser provider is disabled by the owner GUI-safety directive, so neither is ever launched. Only source_supported_facts are handed to the existing Career Ops CV/cover-letter workflow. career-ops/application_pack_review.py is a separate reviewer module that re-reads artifacts, the posting file and the canonical sources and re-derives truthfulness, requirement coverage (essential vs desirable kept separate), consistency, formatting/export readiness and unresolved unknowns; its own output records that this is independent deterministic re-derivation, not a second model. career-ops/submission_gate.py implements no submission path: 14 external actions are refused and logged, and it refuses blocked reviews, unverified truthfulness, missing approvals, approvals not bound to pack_id+pack_sha256, packs changed after approval, unacknowledged unknowns, and approvals stored inside the repository; a valid external approval yields only approved_pending_owner_manual_submission plus an owner checklist, with external_action_performed false on every decision. The acceptance runner (42/42 checks PASS, 0 critical failures) walks job record -> JobBrief -> research -> handoff -> CV + cover-letter drafts -> reviewer -> tamper proof -> submission gate on labelled synthetic fixtures, and a deliberately falsified pack (invented CV line, invented metric, invented first-person CISSP claim) is blocked. A real defect was found by re-running the suite against the committed revision: brief's overloaded --record flag wrote the generated brief over the job-record fixture it had just read; inputs and outputs are now separate flags, a guard refuses any output path that resolves to an input, the fixture is restored and 3 regression tests were added. No application submitted, no employer/recruiter contact, no browser, no network research; canonical sources and trackers byte-identical before/after; both commits pushed.
